lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: graphs tables and equations

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

items.prompt:
Relationship A: y = (2/3)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 4, 8, 12
y: 5, 10, 15
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?

steps: Relationship A has a rate of change of 2/3.
Relationship B has a rate of change of 5/4 (since 5 ÷ 4 = 5/4).
5/4 is greater than 2/3, so Relationship B has the greater rate.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: For the line y = (9/4)x + 13, find y when x = 12.
A line has equation y = (5/4)x - 9. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = (-5/3)x - 16. Write the equation of the line through (3, 10) that is parallel to this line.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 12w + 19, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 12 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 12 centimeters per week.
The plant was 19 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 19 centimeters per week.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 23w + 22, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The plant grows 23 centimeters per week.
The plant grows 22 centimeters per week.
The plant was 23 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant was 22 centimeters tall when it was first measured.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-19, 15) and (35, -33).

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt:
A line passes through these points:
x: -12, -5, 2, 9
y: -14, -4, 6, 16
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A line passes through (-13, 6). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 3 and a vertical leg (rise) of 1. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 3 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
